description: A Python script defining a subclass of Formatter to generate HTML documentation pages, including headers, footers, and methods for converting source code and documentation into HTML format within the FreeType project.

classes.name: HtmlFormatter
classes.description: A subclass of Formatter that converts source code and documentation into styled HTML pages, with methods for handling sections, blocks, markup, and index/table of contents generation.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the HtmlFormatter with project title, file prefix, and HTML headers/footers.

methods.name: make_section_url
methods.description: Creates URL for a section based on its name.

methods.name: make_block_url
methods.description: Creates URL for a block, optionally with a specific name.

methods.name: make_html_word
methods.description: Converts a word into HTML, handling cross-references and markup.

methods.name: make_html_para
methods.description: Converts a list of words into an HTML paragraph with styling and links.

methods.name: make_html_code
methods.description: Converts source code lines into HTML with syntax highlighting.

methods.name: make_html_items
methods.description: Converts a list of items into HTML format.

methods.name: print_html_items
methods.description: Outputs HTML for a list of items.

methods.name: print_html_field
methods.description: Outputs HTML for a field with its items.

methods.name: html_source_quote
methods.description: Converts a line of source code into HTML, handling cross-references and keywords.

methods.name: print_html_field_list
methods.description: Outputs a list of fields as an HTML table.

methods.name: print_html_markup
methods.description: Outputs HTML for markup fields.

methods.name: index_enter
methods.description: Begins index section, initializing index items.

methods.name: index_name_enter
methods.description: Adds a name and URL to the index.

methods.name: index_exit
methods.description: Outputs the complete index as an HTML table.

methods.name: index_dump
methods.description: Dumps the index to a file.

methods.name: toc_enter
methods.description: Begins table of contents section.

methods.name: toc_chapter_enter
methods.description: Outputs HTML for a chapter in TOC.

methods.name: toc_section_enter
methods.description: Outputs HTML for a section in TOC.

methods.name: toc_section_exit
methods.description: Closes section in TOC.

methods.name: toc_chapter_exit
methods.description: Closes chapter in TOC.

methods.name: toc_index
methods.description: Outputs link to the global index in TOC.

methods.name: toc_exit
methods.description: Ends the TOC section.

methods.name: toc_dump
methods.description: Dumps the TOC and index to files.

methods.name: section_enter
methods.description: Outputs HTML for a section, including title, synopsis, description.

methods.name: block_enter
methods.description: Outputs HTML for a block, including source code and header info.

methods.name: markup_enter
methods.description: Outputs HTML for markup within a block.

methods.name: markup_exit
methods.description: Closes markup section.

methods.name: block_exit
methods.description: Closes block HTML.

methods.name: section_exit
methods.description: Closes section HTML.

methods.name: section_dump_all
methods.description: Outputs HTML for all sections.
